points.quote: `workbench.desktop.main.ts` imports the common file plus the `electron-sandbox` and `node` pieces.
`workbench.web.main.ts` imports the common file plus the web-only pieces.
Files, storage, clipboard, the extension host and similar services have web and desktop implementations.
A feature's code is only in a build if one of these files imports it.
Features are usually pulled in by side-effect imports of their `*.contribution.ts` files, which are listed in these entry points.
